newsitem.title: USA: Citizens Utilities sees lower 1997,'98 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Citizens Utilities sees lower 1997,'98 EPS.

text.p: Citizens Utilities Co said on Wednesday that earnings and earnings per share in 1997 and 1998 would likely be below 1996 levels due to accelerated expenses and capital expenditures during those years.

"Increasing communications revenue and revenue opportunities require additional expenses and capital expenditure in 1997 and 1998 to deploy and support Citizens' national distribution network and branding initiative," said Robert DeSantis, Citizens' vice president and treasurer.
